findings.description: Every target parser requires target[0]==/ before any alias or proxy branch is reached, so GET http://host/path HTTP/1.1 can never reach the proxy branch and the absolute-form channel switch is closed by construction for this family.
findings.title: Absolute-form target is a parse 400 on all 11 proxied builds
